title: Generic smooth coordinate reduction for a principal divisor
statement: Let $X$ be a normal separated finite-type $k$-scheme [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], where normal means that every local ring is an integrally closed domain, and let $k$ be the algebraically closed field of [def-trf-coefficient-conventions]. Let $f\in\Gamma(X,\mathcal O_X)$ be not identically zero on any irreducible component of $X$, and let $\xi$ be the generic point of an irreducible component of the closed subscheme $Z=V(f)$ [def-weil-closed-immersion]. There is an open neighbourhood $W$ of $\xi$ such that $Z_{\mathrm{red}}\cap W$ is smooth over $k$ [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms] and there are a smooth morphism $g:W\to\mathbf A^1_k$ and an integer $r\geq1$ with $Z\cap W=V(g^r)$ scheme-theoretically and $f|_W=u g^r$ for some unit $u\in\Gamma(W,\mathcal O_W)^\times$.
